# Nyay Saathi

> Nyay Saathi ("justice companion") is a free, open-source legal-help guide for people in India. You describe your problem in English or Hindi; it gives verified next steps, helplines and official links, checks whether you can get a free lawyer under section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, and drafts the letter you need. No sign-up, no tracking cookies, and nothing you type is saved. Built by Surge Software for Code for a Billion 2026 (MIT licence).

## Problems it covers
- Unpaid wages
- Consumer fraud and defective goods or services
- Violence at home
- Police not filing an FIR
- Cheque bounce
- A stuck government application (RTI)
- Court case status
- Land or tenancy disputes

## What it gives you
- Next steps from a curated, sourced knowledge base. It never makes up a law, deadline or phone number.
- Free legal aid eligibility (women, children, SC/ST, people with disabilities, industrial workers and low-income people qualify by law), with NALSA helpline 15100 and the District Legal Services Authority.
- Draft letters: legal aid application, RTI application, consumer complaint, wage demand, complaint to the Superintendent of Police.
- The cheapest path first: a written demand, consumer helpline grievance, RTI, legal-aid mediation or Lok Adalat.

## Guides (plain HTML, no JavaScript needed)
- [Free legal help websites in India: what each one does](https://nyaysaathi.surgesoftware.co.in/guides/free-legal-help-websites-india): NALSA (15100), Tele-Law, Nyaaya, National Consumer Helpline, RTI Online, e-Courts, and where Nyay Saathi fits.
- [Who can get a free lawyer in India (section 12, Legal Services Authorities Act)](https://nyaysaathi.surgesoftware.co.in/guides/who-can-get-free-lawyer-india): who is entitled, how to apply, and the legal aid application letter.
- [RTI application format](https://nyaysaathi.surgesoftware.co.in/guides/rti-application-format): fee, 30-day reply, first appeal, and the RTI letter.
- [Consumer complaint letter format](https://nyaysaathi.surgesoftware.co.in/guides/consumer-complaint-letter-format): letter to the seller, National Consumer Helpline 1915, e-Daakhil.
- [Unpaid salary or wages demand letter](https://nyaysaathi.surgesoftware.co.in/guides/unpaid-salary-demand-letter): demand letter, Labour Department claim, free legal aid.
- [Police not registering your FIR: complaint to the Superintendent of Police](https://nyaysaathi.surgesoftware.co.in/guides/police-not-registering-fir-complaint-to-sp): section 173(4) and 175(3) BNSS, and the complaint letter.
